objective: server/domain/evidenceLanes.ts laneIdFrom keeps the first 4 meaningful words and falls back to 'evidence' for digit-leading ids, and dedupe keeps the first lane per id. So parseLanes(['Official county fee schedules for recording deeds','Official county fee schedules for recording mortgages']) returns one lane and the REQUIRED mortgages lane silently disappears, letting the gate pass without it; parseLanes(['2024 annual filings','2025 quarterly filings']) collapses to ['evidence']. Fix: when a derived (not declared) id collides, suffix deterministically (_2, _3) in input order; prefix digit-leading derivations (lane_2024_annual_filings) rather than falling back; keep first-wins only for genuinely duplicated declared ids.
expectedOutcome: Every distinct prose lane keeps its own id.

acceptanceConditions.statement: distinct prose lanes never collapse into one id, with a test that fails before the fix

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
